title: GO出行总裁中岛：司机收入提升，年轻司机占比稳步上升
speaker: Taroishi Nakajima

segments.en: Let's talk a little bit more about Japan's unique environment for taxis
segments.zh: 我们再聊聊日本出租车行业的独特环境

segments.en: Given of course the demographic issues here as well where you have a shrinking population
segments.zh: 当然，这里有人口结构问题，人口在减少

segments.en: How does GO play into that landscape?
If you look at the broader trends in Japan's markets
segments.zh: 从日本市场的整体趋势来看

segments.en: The overall taxi market has been gradually shrinking for the past 30 years
segments.zh: 过去30年，出租车市场整体在逐步萎缩

segments.en: But after COVID that trend actually began to reverse slightly and the market has started growing
segments.zh: 但疫情后，这一趋势有所逆转，市场开始增长

segments.en: One major factor in that trend reversal is that with the introduction of GO
segments.zh: 这一逆转的一个主要因素是GO的推出

segments.en: Individual taxi drivers' annual incomes have gradually increased
segments.zh: 出租车司机的年收入逐步提高

segments.en: Being a taxi driver has become a more attractive career
segments.zh: 出租车司机成为更有吸引力的职业

segments.en: And a number of drivers has started to recover
The proportion of taxi drivers in their 20s and 30s is steadily increasing
segments.zh: 20多岁和30多岁的司机比例稳步上升

segments.en: And it's becoming an occupation that can be sufficiently attractive even to younger workers
segments.zh: 这个职业对年轻劳动者也具备了足够的吸引力
